name: Joseph Anderson
headline: Founder & CEO at Connex | We Help eCommerce & ERP Partners Close Deals That Break on Integration
about:
I help ecommerce and ERP partners close deals they would otherwise lose.
 
Most integration projects don’t fail because of the core system—they fail because of the missing workflow between systems.
 Orders, inventory, fulfillment, and accounting don’t line up, and the deal stalls.
 
That’s where Connex comes in.
 
I’m the Founder & CEO of Connex, where we design and deploy order workflow automation for mid-market ecommerce and B2B companies. We connect accounting, commerce, WMS, and fulfillment systems into one reliable workflow—from cart to cash.
 
We typically get pulled in when:
 
 A partner can’t meet a client’s workflow requirements 
 A deal is stuck due to integration gaps 
 A client is scaling and manual processes are breaking 
 A migration (ERP, WMS, or channel expansion) creates complexity 
 
Our partners include:
 
 ERP and accounting implementers (QuickBooks, Sage, NetSuite, etc.) 
 Ecommerce agencies and consultants 
 3PL and WMS providers 
 Integration and technical operations teams 
 
We help them:
 
 Close more deals by solving the “missing piece” 
 Deliver complex workflows without custom dev 
 Support larger, higher-value clients with confidence 
 
Connex automates the full order lifecycle with customizable logic, two-way syncing, and expert onboarding—so teams stop patching systems and start scaling cleanly.
 
I built Connex from $20 into an 8-figure SaaS company, and today we support partners working with complex, multi-system ecommerce environments.
 
📩 If you have deals that stall because systems don’t quite fit together, let’s talk.

experiences.description:
Connex helps ecommerce and ERP partners close deals that break on integration.

Most platforms, agencies, and consultants can win the core system—but lose the deal when the workflow between systems doesn’t work. Orders, inventory, fulfillment, and accounting don’t line up, and the project stalls.

That’s where we come in.

Connex is an order workflow automation platform built for mid-market ecommerce and B2B companies running across multiple systems. We connect selling channels, WMS tools, fulfillment platforms, and accounting systems into one reliable workflow—from cart to cash.

We are typically brought in when:

A partner can’t meet a client’s workflow or integration requirements
A deal is stuck due to accounting, inventory, or fulfillment complexity
A migration (ERP, WMS, or channel expansion) creates operational gaps
Off-the-shelf connectors fail or require too much manual work

Who we work with:

ERP and accounting partners (QuickBooks, Sage, NetSuite, etc.)
Ecommerce agencies and consultants
3PL and WMS providers
Integration and technical operations teams

What we do:

Build and support complex integrations across commerce, fulfillment, and accounting systems
Automate order, inventory, and financial workflows with customizable logic
Provide hands-on onboarding and support so partners don’t need to own long-term integration complexity

The outcome:

Partners close more deals
Clients get workflows that actually work at scale
Teams reduce manual work, errors, and operational risk

I provided technical support to business users and computer programmers for the Sitefinity Content Management System and the Telerik RadControls for ASP.NET AJAX, which are two popular website building products. I also developed E-Commerce and social networking widgets for Sitefinity.

I assisted customers over the phone with general functionality questions about Telerik's website building products. I also administered and programmed their internal corporate intranet for their marketing program.
